page.layout: One page: a printed title line at the top left, partly covered by handwritten flourishes and show-through. No printed text block below it. Handwritten script, flourishes and marks fill the page and both margins, and are not transcribed.
page.notes: Mostly manuscript: a writing-master's flourished exercise (large script "Broome" repeated, ink flourishes, a vertical column of strokes down the left margin, and cursive lines) and a cipher-like line at the top. None of this is printed, so none is transcribed. The printed line "HRISTIAN" in spaced capitals is partly covered by ink and show-through; the initial C is hidden, and a second line beneath it reads only as "CO" under the ink. Show-through from the reverse side appears throughout. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible.
